notes.title: Steam Creature Collector Fest
notes.content:
Ahoy, Tamers!
We’re thrilled to announce that Decklings is part of the Creature Collector Fest on Steam, running from May 12th to 19th, 2025!

This is just the beginning of our journey and we are working hard to bring you our demo soon.

Want to be among the first to play?

Wishlist Decklings and join our Discord to get notified and take part in upcoming closed beta tests!

[url=https://dsc.gg/darklizardgames]Link to Discord[/url]
